282043810.description:
Blue Agate Geode Specimen
Standing Polished Crystal Display Stone
Natural Agate, Approximately 7.5 Inches Tall
This striking free-standing agate geode specimen features a polished front face displaying rich concentric banding in vivid shades of blue, white, and translucent chalcedony. At the center lies an open hollow cavern lined with sparkling quartz druzy crystals. The reverse maintains its raw geological matrix, creating a dramatic organic contrast ideal for mineral collections, bookshelf display, or interior decor.
Polished front face revealing distinct concentric agate banding and deep blue coloration
Hollow central cavity lined with natural sparkling quartz druzy crystals
Natural rough stone rind preserved across the sides and back
Flat cut base with protective felt lining for stable upright display
Condition:
Polished front face retains a high gloss with smooth edges and no chips. Internal druzy crystal cavity is intact and cleanly formed. Reverse matrix shows natural geological rough texture and fissures inherent to raw stone. Protective felt on base exhibits light surface wear and edge rubbing from prior display.
